name: Password Manager
description: Organize local passwords in nested groups. Vault always AES-GCM encrypted; optional Argon2id master password.
releaseNotes: v0.3.1: fix vault.key write order (key before envelope), 0600 key permissions, skip rewriting key on every save, lock clears memory even if persist fails, migrate failures no longer silent.
